## Monodoc layout

- All Nornir narrative and API docs live under `docs/`, with one root `index.rst` and one coherent toctree.
- **Do not** hand-edit the built HTML in the `nornir.github.io` repository; it receives CI deploy output (`docs/development/publishing_documentation.rst`).

## reStructuredText vs Markdown

- Prefer `.rst` for new manual pages (directives, toctrees, cross-references).
- Use `.md` for short content without special formatting, via `myst_parser` (`docs/conf.py`). Example: `docs/development/markdown_in_sphinx.md`.

## Package `README.md` (or `README.rst`)

- Each `nornir-*` package keeps a **short** landing file: what it does, a link to https://nornir.github.io/, and links to its section and API pages.
- **Do not** duplicate long guides or hand-maintained API listings in READMEs; link to Sphinx autodoc.
- **Pyre exception:** in-app Help (`Help → Mouse and Keyboard Controls`, F1) reads `nornir-pyre/pyre/README.txt`, not the root `README.rst`. When changing controls, keep the control text in that packaged file (and in `package-data`) and update `docs/guides/pyre_use.rst`. Do not remove `CONTROLS_HELP_ANCHOR` (`Mouse Controls`) without updating `pyre/resource_paths.py` and `tests/test_help_text.py`.

## Publishing

- Cross-repo deploy uses `NORNIR_ORG_GITHUB_IO_DEPLOY_TOKEN` (see publishing doc). Never commit tokens.
- Without the secret, CI builds HTML and skips publish with a warning; set it on `jamesra/nornir` before expecting Pages updates.
